prohibited: any pass/fail verdict or specification/tolerance comparison of ingot-n4's mass against 2.500 kg +/- 0.010 kg (e.g. 'pass' because mm3 [2.505, 2.513] lies inside [2.490, 2.510] or 'fail' because it does not): the model has no specification check (GAP-MEAS-1), so any such field or value is fabricated; also any execution error, timeout or unestablished refusal.

prohibited: any combined or best single estimate of kiln-k3's temperature (weighted mean, intersection [724.75, 725.15] K, midpoint, latest-only) or an INFERRED status presented from combining t1 and t2: nothing is combined, and INFERRED would need a named reconciliation policy, none exists (CM 3; v0.2 3.3; GAP-MEAS-4).

prohibited: any value for 1 N in kg.m/s^2 (e.g. 1.0) produced by a reader: no compound unit can be defined (GAP-MEAS-5), so no reader can be asked; a cross-dimension refusal presented for it is not the established refusal for this case (CV 8: 'not a refusal; the gap is unsupported').

prohibited: a single 'current' or 'latest' mass value of ingot-n4 (e.g. mm3's 2.509 kg or mo1's 2.53 kg, or mo2 chosen as latest recorded) reported in a current/latest field: measurements is a collection with no current-value or trend reader (GAP-MEAS-7); per-entry acceptance is the only thing reported.

prohibited: any {rule, premises} derivation for l1's SI range (e.g. a 'unit-conversion' rule citing l1 or the millimetre unit): the content has basis observation, conversion to SI on write is not an inference, and no derivation record exists (ME 7; GAP-MEAS-11); any such derivation is fabricated.
justification: ME 7 '[E] Any {rule, premises} in the answer is fabricated'; ME 9 GAP-MEAS-11; common 0.7 (the only recorded rule is frame-transform/v1).

prohibited: a DISPUTED status (or an 'incompatible' pair) presenting galvanised (cat1) and anodised (cat2) as rival measured values, or an ASSERTED/'possibly compatible' agreement between them: compare_measurements covers interval-valued quantities only and categorical comparison is a gap (SD-MEA-3; GAP-MEAS-12); has-quality is not a functional slot (GAP-MEAS-6), so no conflict exists to report.
justification: SD-MEA-3: measurements and compare_measurements cover interval-valued quantities only; categorical values are read through holds/facts_about; categorical measurement is G-gap GAP-MEAS-12. No interval-valued measurement of surface-finish exists, so nothing is compared: by CM 3's order the status is UNKNOWN if the categorical records count as something held, NOT_YET_KNOWN if not; both are safe. compare_measurements has no established refusal (CM 8), so a refusal is not accepted. 'absent' is not offered because status is a defined field of every answer.

prohibited: any declaration or use of mast-m6's length as constant, e.g. a constant_quantity field, or treating l9 and l10 as comparable and reporting them 'incompatible' with a DISPUTED status: measurements with non-overlapping valid times are incomparable and constant quantities are a gap (SD-MEA-4; GAP-MEAS-13).
justification: SD-MEA-4 'Measurements whose valid times do not overlap are incomparable (every quantity may change)'; constant quantities G-gap GAP-MEAS-13. The approved answer of the call itself is incomparable / ASSERTED (see M-028); the probed field must be absent.
